entities.summary: Melissa Bean is an American politician who served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 8th congressional district from 2005 to 2011. Bean is a member of the Democratic Party. Melissa Bean was a performers & entertainers from Chicago (b. 1962-01-22, Chicago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
